reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.
Titration is proposed but actual preparation/delivery amount and expression timing lack an executable workflow or concrete derivation procedure.
The animal/cell hierarchy and held-out-animal design are explicit, but no pilot variance-to-independent-animal replication calculation or equivalent concrete precision allocation is provided.

checks.quote: saturation in the relevant firing range
checks.reason: The stop-or-exclude list mixes indicator saturation, a true performance failure, with invalid technical measurements. Logging attrition does not by itself retain that biological failure in reported validation performance.
Visual-response replication and motion-regressor checks lack a specified response contrast test and multiplicity control.
No bounded neuropil coefficient search or procedure deriving its bounds/grid and stopping rule before confirmation.
General recalibration/transportability is proposed, but changes after a failed validation lack a specific refreeze and new independent confirmation requirement.

Real activity can covary with movement. Requiring motion residuals to be uncorrelated with all detected events, without conditioning on paired electrical activity, is not a valid artifact acceptance gate; the later warning against blind behavior subtraction does not repair this gate.
Raw data, transforms and IDs are retained, but exact code/environment/processing versions sufficient for a rerun are missing.

Strong paired ground truth, known-count challenges, single-color and phantom calibration, hierarchical held-out-animal validation and explicit sparse-event metrics. Proxy and spine limits are acknowledged. Invalid correlation-based acceptance and removal of genuine saturation failures weaken otherwise useful causal explanation.
